description: Returns the Isto Intents intent servers whose last automated check passed and that serve the given country and category (and language, if given): operator, host, MCP url, what they serve and when they were checked. The list is in no order of preference; if several fit, let the user choose. Connect to a returned url to publish the user's intent there. Data: https://istointents.org/registry.json (CC BY 4.0).

category.description: vehicle, property, or a category URI

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, e.g. SK, CZ, AT

language.description: optional BCP 47 language the user wants to be served in, e.g. sk, cs, de

name: registry_find_holders
title: Find intent servers for a country and category
